# gray_spatula — Round 2 realism review

Evidence: f1119, f1123, f1133; source index / 30 gives capture seconds. Three calibrated photo/render/overlay comparisons: [review.jpg](review.jpg). This is offline reconstruction, not online estimation.

Grades: {'silhouette': 'B', 'proportions': 'B', 'colour_texture': 'B', 'articulation': 'B', 'physics': 'B', 'collision': 'A', 'instances': 'B'}. Mean visible-region IoU: 0.8419; median colour ΔE76: 10.85; histogram TV: 0.729. The unchanged grading thresholds and correlated-mask limitations are documented in [../qa_summary.md](../qa_summary.md).

## Round 2 repairs

- Gave the flexible scoop a 3mm shell prior, retained silicone/bamboo component physics, and narrowed the over-scaled bamboo shaft.
- Extended the concealed shaft to first modeled support; retained the explicit rigid fallback for the deformable head.

## Physics and contacts

Canonical envelope [0.097679, 0.33338, 0.022351] m; dry mass estimate 0.03943 kg; material density 1150 kg/m³; friction 0.8; restitution 0.08. See model.json for material components, inertia, COM, uncertainty and deformable fallback parameters. Product mass is not measured. There are 74 closed convex pieces; contact margin 0.0001 m. Container membership is not a weld or rigid articulation.

## Remaining limits

- Exact product identity, weighed mass and measured friction remain unavailable; density-derived masses and contact coefficients are explicit priors.
- Illumination is approximate. Photo histograms and source-colour reflection maps are not calibrated albedo or HDR radiance measurements.
- Only the marked visible region is scored. Hidden dimensions and surface details remain bounded construction assumptions.
- Elastic material parameters are tentative metadata. The delivered Blender/GLB contact model is the rigid fallback; no deformable solver validation was performed.

## Rebuild

Run Blender with `-b -P build.py`; the shared generator reads `../assets.json`, `../build_common.py` and `../qa_geometry.py`. OBJ coordinates are canonical metres, +Z up. GLB is glTF +Y up; Blender dynamic origins are at COM. Repeat the calibrated render, collision and metadata checks after rebuilding; old QA grades must not be assumed valid after edits.

physics_properties.mass_source: Sum of signed visual solid volumes after welding GLB UV/normal seams, multiplied by material density. Manufacturing submesh overlaps are not boolean-unioned; estimate is not a weighed product. Collision shell chord volumes are not used as material mass.
physics_properties.centre_of_mass_method: Density-weighted convex compound approximation, with separate polymer/steel or bamboo/silicone components; patch overlap remains approximate.

material_model.type: corotational elastic silicone head with rigid handle
material_model.status: tentative; metadata only, exported Blender/GLB remain rigid fallback

physics_properties.articulation: No rigid joint observed; utensils are independently removable. Parent references are containment, except the organizer drawer transform.

density_mass_estimate.method: Sum of signed visual solid volumes after welding GLB UV/normal seams, multiplied by material density. Manufacturing submesh overlaps are not boolean-unioned; estimate is not a weighed product. Collision shell chord volumes are not used as material mass.

physics_properties.mass_justification: 0.03943 kg from visual solid material volumes multiplied by nominal densities; manufacturing overlaps and unobserved construction remain uncertain. See density_mass_estimate.
physics_properties.density_volume_caveat: Sum includes overlapping convex patches; cavity geometry does not fill the bounding box. Composite materials and coating thickness are approximate.
physics_properties.blender_dynamic_origin: COM; custom property canonical_com_offset maps back to canonical OBJ/GLB frame. World-space geometry stays unchanged.

provenance.geometry: Reconstructed from kitchen video; hidden surfaces are completed. Scale and material appearance remain approximate.
provenance.motion: Observed trajectories where documented; unobserved axes and endpoints are assumptions.
provenance.forces: Simulation measurements of assumed parameters; not force measurements from video.

visual_bindings_note: Visuals use the latest asset revision; mechanism geometry may predate it. Body rest offsets preserve the visual placement.
